blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The suspension order issued by the Sandiganbayan against Senators Rodante Marcoleta and Jinggoy Estrada will be held in abeyance pending the final resolution of their motions for reconsideration, according to Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian. Gatchalian confirmed that the Senate has already received the suspension orders from the anti-graft court. “We also received letters from Senators Jinggoy Estrada and Rodante Marcoleta asking that their suspensions be held in abeyance because we heard that they would file motions for reconsideration,” Gatchalian said in an interview with radio dzBB on Sunday. “Once a motion for reconsideration is filed, the suspension will […]...
